transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm not taking up an appointment someone else needed, but... I guess I've just been feeling a little off lately. 

I came in because I barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself anymore. Like, I used to love my dance class, and hiking, and trying out new recipes... but now even game night just sits there like a chore that I keep putting off. 

I know it probably just sounds like I'm being lazy, and I'm really trying hard to snap out of it, I promise. But... I don't know, does that make sense? Is that an okay reason to be here?
Have you experienced a decrease in pleasure from activities you normally enjoy?

Yeah, exactly... I'm sorry, I know I just kind of rambled about that a second ago. But yes, that's exactly it. Um, things like my dance class, or hiking... even just trying out a new recipe. I used to really look forward to all of that. Now, even game night with my friends just feels like this big chore that I keep trying to find excuses to get out of. 

I really don't want to sound ungrateful for the good things in my life, because I know I'm lucky. I just... I don't know why I can't seem to enjoy them right now. Is it normal to feel like that?
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I wouldn't say I feel sad, really. Or empty. I mean, I have my moments, just like anybody else, but I really try hard to stay positive. 

I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around crying all day or feeling sorry for myself, because I'm definitely not. I always try to keep a smile on and be upbeat for the people around me. It's really just that... that lack of interest in things that I mentioned before. 

I hope it's okay that I'm not feeling sad? Like, I know people usually come to doctors like you when they're crying all the time, so I hope I'm still making sense and giving you the right answers.
Have you been feeling tired or having low energy lately?

No, I wouldn't say I'm unusually tired. I mean, I have enough energy to get through the day and take care of what needs to be done around the house. I try really hard to keep up with everything. 

I might get a little worn out sometimes, but I think that's just normal, right? Like, everyone gets tired. I don't feel like I'm dragging myself around or anything like that. I really try to push through if I'm ever feeling a bit slow. Is that the kind of answer you were looking for?
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?

Oh, um, no, my appetite is pretty much the exact same. I always make sure to eat my meals, because I know it's really important to take care of yourself. I definitely don't skip meals or anything like that—I wouldn't want to cause any extra problems, you know? 

So, yeah, I'm eating just fine. I hope that's a good thing? Like, I know some people completely lose their appetite when they're having a hard time, so I hope it doesn't seem like I'm not taking this seriously just because I'm still eating normally. I'm really trying to do all the right things. Is that the kind of information you need?
Have you been having any trouble sleeping lately?

Um, no, my sleep is actually pretty good. I always make sure to go to bed at a reasonable hour, because I know getting enough rest is super important. I really try to stick to a good schedule so I don't cause any extra issues for myself, you know? 

So, I usually just sleep right through the night. I hope that's alright? Like, I know a lot of people probably come in and say they can't sleep at all, so I hope it doesn't seem like I'm wasting your time just because my sleep is okay. I just want to make sure I'm answering everything correctly for you. Am I doing okay?
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Um... well... I try really hard to stay positive, you know? I don't want to sit around feeling sorry for myself or make a big deal out of things. But... yeah, I guess I have been feeling a little guilty lately. 

I just... I keep telling myself that I really should have known better than to take that booking in the first place. And, um, I feel like I failed the people who were helping me, by not keeping them safe. I know I probably shouldn't beat myself up over it, and I'm really trying to focus on moving forward, I promise. I just hope it's okay that I feel that way? Like, I hope I'm not overreacting or being too negative by admitting that. Does that make sense to you?
How long have you been feeling this way, with a lack of interest in activities you normally enjoy?

Um... well, it hasn't been forever, I promise. I really try to keep busy and do things, but... I guess it's been going on since the robbery happened. That was at a festival job I took about two years and three months ago. 

I know that sounds like a really long time to still be stuck like this, and I'm really sorry if it seems like I'm just not trying hard enough to get over it. I really am trying to get back to my normal self. I just... I haven't quite figured out how to enjoy things the same way since then. Is it okay that it's been that long? I hope you don't think I'm just being lazy or giving up.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on things lately?

Um, well, I really try to stay on top of things, I promise. I don't want to let my brain just turn to mush or use it as an excuse, you know? But... I guess maybe a little bit? 

Like, when I sit down to try and work on my catering forms, or, um, I was looking at a Chamber application recently... I just find myself reading the exact same line over and over again. And then I get completely stuck on these really small choices, like what price to put down on a sheet, or even just figuring out which email I should answer first. 

I know it sounds kind of silly, getting hung up on such little things, and I really am trying to push through it and focus better. I hope it doesn't make me sound incompetent or anything? I just want to be totally honest so I can give you the right information. Am I explaining that okay?
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or the opposite, feeling restless and fidgety?

Um... no, not really. I try really hard to keep my energy up and stay engaged, you know? I don't want to seem sluggish or like I'm bouncing off the walls or anything. So, no, I haven't really noticed any big changes in how fast I move or talk. 

I mean, I hope I'm not doing it right now and just not realizing it? I really try to just be normal and steady. I haven't had anyone point it out to me, either. Is that the right answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to know.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

Um, no, my weight has stayed pretty much the same, I think. I really try to make sure I'm eating enough and taking care of myself, you know? I don't want to let my health slip or anything like that. 

So, no, I haven't lost a bunch of weight. I try to keep a pretty normal routine with meals, even when I'm not feeling my best. I hope that's a good thing? I just want to make sure I'm doing all the right things to stay healthy. Is it okay that my weight hasn't changed?
Have you been feeling worthless or like you're not a good person?

Um, well... I mean, I really try to stay positive and be a good person, you know? I always try to do my best and be helpful to others. I don't want you to think I sit around feeling sorry for myself or hating who I am. 

I guess... I mean, everyone has moments where they feel like they could do better, right? But I wouldn't say I feel completely worthless or anything like that. I try really hard to focus on the good things and be productive. 

I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right impression. I really am trying my best to keep a good attitude. Is it normal to just have regular doubts sometimes, as long as it's not all the time?
Would you say your lack of interest in activities is mild, moderate, or severe?

Um, I guess maybe... mild? I mean, I really don't want to sound like I've just given up on everything, because I haven't. I still try to keep busy and be a good friend and everything. 

It's just... well, I guess I did come in because I've noticed I barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself. Like, I used to love my dance class, and going hiking, and trying out new recipes. Even game night with my friends... lately, they all just kind of sit there like chores that I keep putting off. 

But I'm really trying to push through it, you know? I don't want to be a downer or let people down. I'm hoping if I just keep trying, the excitement will come back. Is that a normal way to handle it? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right things to get back to normal.
Have you been having thoughts about death or dying lately?

Oh! Um, no. No, definitely not. I mean, I know I've been struggling a little bit with my motivation and stuff lately, but I would never... I really value my life, you know? 

I'm trying so hard to get better. I don't want you to worry that I'm, like, giving up completely or a danger to myself or anything. So, no thoughts like that at all. I really want to be here and I want to fix things so I can get back on track. 

That's a good sign, isn't it? That I'm still fighting and wanting to be okay? I just want to make sure you know I'm really committed to getting through this.
How many months have you been feeling a lack of interest in your usual activities?

Um... well, it's been a while, I guess. I mean, I really didn't want to admit it was becoming a problem, because I kept thinking I could just snap out of it if I tried harder. 

But, um, I suppose it's been going on since... since that robbery happened. I was working at a festival, and... well, that was about two years and three months ago. 

I know that sounds like a really long time to let this go on, but I promise I've been trying to stay positive the whole time. I just kept hoping things would go back to the way they were before. It's okay that it took me this long to ask for help, right? I just wanted to handle it on my own so I wouldn't be a burden.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?

Oh, no, never. I promise. Um, kind of like I was saying before, I really do value my life and I'm just here to get better. I would never want to hurt myself. 

I know I've let things slip a little bit since everything happened, but I'm really trying to be proactive now. I hope you don't think I'm, like, completely falling apart or anything... I'm doing okay in that department, I swear. I'm just trying to take care of myself the best I can. That's the right attitude to have, isn't it? I just really want to make sure I'm doing everything right so I can get back to being myself.
Has your lack of interest in activities lasted for more than two years?

Um, yes... yeah, like I mentioned a second ago, it's been about two years and three months. 

I know hearing it said out loud like that makes it sound really bad... I'm sorry, I really didn't mean to let it go on for so long without fixing it. I just kept thinking tomorrow would be the day I finally got my energy back, you know? I hope you don't think I'm just lazy or anything. I really have been trying to push through it on my own. 

I'm here now, though, and I'm ready to do whatever you tell me to do. That's the important part, right?
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities and feelings of guilt are interfering with your daily life and relationships?

Um... well, I guess it has affected things a little bit. I mean, I'm still trying my best, I promise. But, um... I did miss the application deadlines for the Chamber of Commerce, and I've kind of had to put my catering plans on hold. 

I just... I can't seem to reliably handle all the paperwork and the jobs and dealing with people the way I used to before. I know that sounds terrible, like I'm just giving up, but I really am trying. I've also been seeing my friends a lot less... it just feels like my life has gotten a lot smaller, you know? Like I'm just trying to stick to what feels safe right now. 

I hope you don't think I'm just making excuses. I really want to get back to doing all those things, and I'm hoping you can help me figure out how. It's normal to struggle with this stuff a little bit after something scary happens, right? I just want to make sure I'm not doing something wrong.
Would you describe your overall mood as mildly, moderately, or severely depressed?

Um... I guess I would say mildly. Yeah, mildly depressed. I mean, I'm definitely not severely depressed or anything like that. I still get out of bed every day and try to keep things tidy around the house. I'm really trying to keep it together, I promise. 

It's just sort of a... a mild feeling, you know? Like a little bit of a slump. I know I shouldn't be complaining when so many people have it so much worse. I hope it doesn't sound like I'm whining or making a big deal out of nothing. It's just a little mild thing I need to work through. That makes sense, right? It's okay to feel just a little bit down sometimes?
Has your lack of interest in activities been present for most of the day, nearly every day?

Um... I wouldn't say it's all day, every day. No, definitely not. I mean, I still have moments where I can get things done, you know? 

It's just... maybe it comes and goes a little bit? Like, I'll have a few hours where I just can't seem to get motivated, but I always try to snap out of it. I really do try to push myself to stay busy. I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around doing nothing all day. 

I guess it happens often enough that I noticed it, but... it's not a constant thing. That's a good sign, right? Like, it means I'm not doing too badly if I can still have some good parts of the day?
